Summarize and check feed & water intake

Source: R/merge_feed_water_summary.R
merge_feed_water_summary.Rd

This function summarizes daily feed and water intake, visit duration, and counts, and updates intake warnings.

Usage

merge_feed_water_summary(feed = NULL, water = NULL, warn, cfg = qc_config())

Arguments

feed

A data frame of feed visits.

water

A data frame of drinking visits.

warn

A warning skeleton (e.g., from qc_warning_skeleton()).

cfg

A config list. See qc_config().

Value

A list of:

  • summary: merged data frame of daily intake, duration, and visit counts

  • warn: updated warnings

Examples

feed <- tibble::tibble(
  date = as.Date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-01")),
  cow = c("A", "B"),
  intake = c(20, 80),
  duration = c(200, 300)
)

water <- tibble::tibble(
  date = as.Date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-01")),
  cow = c("A", "B"),
  intake = c(50, 200),
  duration = c(100, 150)
)

warn <- tibble::tibble(
  date = as.Date("2024-01-01"),
  low_daily_feed_intake_cows = NA_character_,
  high_daily_feed_intake_cows = NA_character_,
  low_daily_water_intake_cows = NA_character_,
  high_daily_water_intake_cows = NA_character_
)

cfg <- qc_config()
merge_feed_water_summary(feed, water, warn, cfg)
#> $summary
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   date       cow   feeding_intake feeding_duration feeding_visits
#>   <date>     <chr>          <dbl>            <dbl>          <int>
#> 1 2024-01-01 A                 20              200              1
#> 2 2024-01-01 B                 80              300              1
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: drinking_intake <dbl>, drinking_duration <dbl>,
#> #   drinking_visits <int>
#> 
#> $warn
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   date       low_daily_feed_intake_cows high_daily_feed_intake_cows
#>   <date>     <chr>                      <chr>                      
#> 1 2024-01-01 A, 20                      B, 80                      
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: low_daily_water_intake_cows <chr>,
#> #   high_daily_water_intake_cows <chr>
#>
